title: Conversus Validator Error Object
description: Structured error object emitted by SchemaValidator per v4.2.0 spec § 4.9 (C9). Stable interface across schema versions; consumer tooling can rely on the failure surface.

field_path.description: JSON pointer to the offending field, e.g., '/body/disputes/0/severity'.

expected_type.description: The schema-declared expected shape (type or pattern or enum).

actual_value.description: The actual value at field_path; may be any JSON type or null when field is missing.

severity.description: Optional severity field emitted by the Pydantic ValidationWarning model (per spec § 5.1 F2). Not required by § 4.9 but emitted for consumer convenience; defaults to 'warning'.
